summary: The figure shows the distribution of malaria cases by country in 2021. Nigeria accounts for the highest proportion of cases at 26.6%, followed by the Democratic Republic of the Congo at 12.3%. Several other African countries contribute smaller percentages, with many countries having less than 5% each. The chart highlights the concentration of malaria cases in specific countries.
